I fixed the bug: `![x\"x](x)` with `-x smarty` now outputs `

`, which matches the unescaped case. Nothing is committed. **Cause:** a backslash escape is replaced by a placeholder during parsing. The placeholder was turned back into the real character by `UnescapePostprocessor`, which runs on the final HTML text. By then the serializer had already escaped attribute values, so a raw `"` ended up inside `alt="…"`. Smarty triggers this because it adds `"` and `'` to the characters that can be escaped. Link titles had the same bug: `[a](x "t\"q")` produced `title="t"q"`. **Fix (`markdown/treeprocessors.py`):** I added an `UnescapeTreeprocessor`, registered as `'unescape'` at priority 0. It restores the escaped characters in element text, tails and attribute values *before* serialization, so the serializer then escapes them properly. I left the old `UnescapePostprocessor` registered as a fallback: it no longer finds anything in the tree, but it still catches stashed content, and any extension that refers to `md.postprocessors['unescape']` keeps working. **One visible change in output:** `\>` now comes out as `>` instead of a raw `>`. It's equivalent HTML, but it changed one expected line in the existing fixture `tests/basic/backlash-escapes.html`, which I updated. **Tests:** - New `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_smarty.py`: escaped `"` in an image alt (inline and reference style) and in a link title, escaped `'` in an alt, escaped quotes in text, and normal smart quotes. - New `test_escaped_chars_in_alt` in `tests/test_syntax/inline/test_images.py`, covering core behavior without smarty. - Without the fix, 4 of the new tests fail; with it, they all pass. - Full suite (`.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover tests`): 8 failures. They are the same 8 failures, in the HTML-block and md_in_html tests, that occur without my change. - `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests` doesn't get as far as running anything: collection stops on a `PytestCollectionWarning` about `TestSuite` in `test_md_in_html.py`. That happens without my change too, which is why I used unittest. **Docs:** I added the new treeprocessor to the table in `docs/extensions/api.md` and a bug-fix entry to `docs/change_log/release-3.4.md`.
